Please note that, pursuant to a Scheme of Amalgamation effective 1 October 2025, Ram Ratna Research and Holdings Private Limited (RRRHPL) and Jag-Bid Finvest Private Limited (JBFPL) were merged into Hemlata Home Solutions Private Limited (HHSPL), all being part of the Promoter Group entities. As a result, the shareholding of RRRHPL and JBFPL in the Company was transferred to and held by HHSPL. Further, due to the dissolution of RRRHPL and JBFPL pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation, their names have been removed from the Promoter Group. Subsequently, HHSPL was converted into a Limited Liability Partnership under the name Hemlata Home Solutions LLP (HHS LLP) with effect from 27 January 2026. However, the name HHSPL continues to appear as a Promoter Group member in the beneficial position (BENPOS) data as of 31 March 2026, as the process of updating the name in its demat account is still ongoing. HHSPLs name is therefore reflected in the shareholding pattern pursuant to the BENPOS data, pending its name change in the depository system.
The Company has received declarations from the Significant Beneficial Owners confirming that their indirect holding through HHS LLP, along with their direct shareholding, exceeds 10% of the Companys paid-up share capital. Accordingly, in the SBO details provided in this shareholding pattern, the name HHS LLP (formerly HHSPL) has been disclosed even though the BENPOS data as of 31 March 2026 still reflects the name HHSPL.
